notes: The לְ of לִפְקֻדָּתָם is rendered *according to* and was headed on the connective *to*. Rule 24 heads a multi-word English preposition on the token carrying the lexeme (`מִן` → *out of* heads on *out*), and the corpus heads לְ → *according to* on *according* in 117 units and on *to* in none.
